newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish heating plant to issue PLN 21 mln CPs.
newsitem.headline: Polish heating plant to issue PLN 21 mln CPs.

text.p: The Gdansk electrical heating plant group Zespol Elektrocieplowni Gdansk SA will issue 21.07 million zlotys of three-year commercial paper to pay for part of the group's modernisation scheme, it said.
It said in a statement that Poland's PKO BP state savings bank and U.S.-based CS First Boston will be the issue's agents.
The paper will be based on the 52-week T-bill yield plus an interest margin and will be sold to 300 domestic and international investors.
The group wants to allocate some 127 million zlotys for plant modernisation.
